prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Antimony (안티모니) itself — the sovereign of the Antimony Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.
Face — her own: a sharp, striking, intense look; deep brown skin; heart-shaped face; medium-sized eyes — deep-set eyes, outer eye corners slightly lifted; sharp angled brows; aquiline nose; full heart-shaped lips; amber eyes; smoky dark eye makeup.
Body and hair: lean and toned — a slim, firm waist with softly defined vertical abs and lightly sculpted arms and shoulders, a full bust build; sleek slicked-back hair with no bangs, forehead bare; kohl-black hair with streaks of bluish-silver metallic needle sheen.
Expression: a faint knowing smile.
Her element, carried in her design: antimony: a brittle, bluish-silver metalloid whose grey sulfide ore, stibnite, grows in long metallic needles and was ground five thousand years ago into black kohl to line the eyes, its Latin name stibium giving the symbol Sb; alchemists called molten stibnite the grey wolf of metals because it devoured every base metal mixed into gold and left only the pure gold behind; it expands as it freezes, sharpening the letters of cast type, and cooling ingots bloom with fern-like star patterns.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. Bluish-silver armor etched with fern-like star patterns over a kohl-black inner suit, a symmetrical pair of mechanical sub-arms reaching from her back and ending in clusters of long grey needle-crystal claws, a narrow visor of cold infrared sensors resting on her brow above dark-lined eyes, a lapis-blue core at the chest; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: a symmetrical pair of mechanical sub-arms reaching out from her back, ending in shields or tools — her own two human arms stay as they are. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Colours: kohl black, bluish silver, stibnite lead grey, sun-baked sand gold, deep lapis blue.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, a mountain citadel that sees in the dark: watchtowers whose cold infrared eyes of indium antimonide read the faint heat of everything moving through the night, spires clustered like grey needle crystals along the ridge, bluish-silver walls etched with fern-like star patterns.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Sb) and atomic number (51) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
